logical_contracts.name: UpstreamCore
logical_contracts.invariant: NVIDIA-compatible behavior remains isolated and synchronizable.
logical_contracts.verification: A01 vendor/tests/license byte parity + docs/project/lock/workflow fixture parity + staged-layout GREEN + official pinned NVIDIA Python-3.13/Sphinx-9 CI SUCCESS; local exact-lock reproduction remains ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED but is not mislabeled GREEN; A02 pinned upstream CI matrix 10/10 GREEN, but downstream semantic config-override parity remains a separate blocker

logical_contracts.name: SemanticBuild
logical_contracts.invariant: Canonical Markdown is built from resolved Sphinx semantics, not final HTML.

logical_contracts.name: MarkdownPageRouting
logical_contracts.invariant: html/dirhtml/suffix modes map each document deterministically to Markdown URLs/files.
logical_contracts.verification: A02 preserved upstream suite exercises html/dirhtml, file/url/auto/both/replace suffix modes and published link locations across the successful pinned matrix

logical_contracts.name: NodeAdapterRegistry
logical_contracts.invariant: Known custom semantic nodes are rendered by explicit adapters; registration is inspectable.

logical_contracts.name: DirectiveCompatibility
logical_contracts.invariant: Enabled extensions lose no unexplained semantic content.

logical_contracts.name: CurationPolicy
logical_contracts.invariant: Inclusion/exclusion/order/code/size behavior is deterministic and separately configurable.

logical_contracts.name: LlmsIndex
logical_contracts.invariant: llms.txt is small, semantic, link-based, described, and deterministic.

logical_contracts.name: LlmsFull
logical_contracts.invariant: llms-full.txt is optional, bounded, never silently truncated, and reports skip/note policy.

logical_contracts.name: ArtifactManifest
logical_contracts.invariant: Every represented document has a machine-readable inventory record.

logical_contracts.name: CompatibilityReport
logical_contracts.invariant: Node classes, handling mode, unknowns, and losses are counted and reviewable.

logical_contracts.name: Provenance
logical_contracts.invariant: Each artifact records source kind, fidelity, hashes, transforms, warnings, and generation origin.

logical_contracts.name: SummaryGeneration
logical_contracts.invariant: Optional LLM summaries are opt-in, credential-safe, cached, provenance-recorded, and fallback-safe.
logical_contracts.verification: A02 pinned upstream 10-cell matrix executes summary/cache/security tests including html/dirhtml and parallel/sequential modes; A10 still owns downstream provenance/provider hardening

logical_contracts.name: HtmlCompatibilityFallback
logical_contracts.invariant: Static generated HTML without canonical Sphinx representation can be converted offline and labeled compatibility fidelity.

logical_contracts.name: ConsumerBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Runtime consumers use static artifacts; any Python build-time consumer uses only an explicit public facade, never private vendor internals.

logical_contracts.name: DiscoveryLinks
logical_contracts.invariant: Published HTML advertises canonical Markdown and applicable llms.txt without exposing secrets.

logical_contracts.name: LocaleVersionRouting
logical_contracts.invariant: Version/language builds cannot cross-link to the wrong artifact set.

logical_contracts.name: RawContentSafety
logical_contracts.invariant: Executable/raw browser markup cannot pass into agent Markdown without explicit sanitization policy.

logical_contracts.name: OptionalDependencyBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Missing optional generation/provider dependencies degrade explicitly without breaking deterministic representation.

logical_contracts.name: PrimaryBuildSemanticContext
logical_contracts.invariant: The Markdown sub-build receives every primary-build semantic input required to resolve the same document content, including tags, confdir, and explicit config overrides.
logical_contracts.verification: A02 upstream tags/confdir GREEN; downstream integrity-checked config snapshot shim implemented outside vendor; 10 config-transfer tests + 14 matrix/orchestration tests + 11 closure/provenance tests + 6 reconciliation-readiness tests GREEN; dedicated opt-in CircleCI workflow and read-only receipt preparer present; real downstream parity remains 0/10 GREEN and A03 stays locked.
